title: Tyrannosaurus rex
summary: Tyrannosaurus rex was a large theropod dinosaur that lived in forested river valleys of western North America about 66 to 68 million years ago, in the latest Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous. Tyrannosaurids were the dominant predators of their time and region. Tyrannosaurus is among the last non-avian dinosaurs known before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction.

uncertainty.note: Years are computed as 1950 minus years before present, from the approximate range 66 to 68 million years ago given by the Burke Museum (University of Washington). The Featured Wikipedia article gives 69 to 66 Ma for the same species; the record uses the institutional figure and flags the difference in reviewer_note.
